stem.alt: Logic circuit with inputs A and B and output Y. Input A goes through a NOT gate into the first input of a NAND gate; input B goes to the second input of the same NAND gate. Branches of A and B also feed a NOR gate (B to its upper input, A to its lower input). The outputs of the NAND gate and the NOR gate are the two inputs of a final NOR gate, whose output is Y.
